name: Hiiragi Yuuna
source:
She has a positive personality and is a hard worker.
She balances her studies with helping out at the inn.

Her family runs a famous, long-established inn, and she was raised by her kind parents.
After her parents died in an accident, she actively supports her older sister Ayaka, who has become the young innkeeper.
